verdict.rationale: dlt explicitly infers/normalizes schemas, handles nested data into typed relational tables, and supports merge/dedup via primary_key/merge_key upserts rather than raw JSON dumps, with a queryable dataset interface (SQL/dataframe/Ibis) for analytics engineers. Runtime probes confirm the pipeline actually runs and loads verified sources into typed destination tables. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on benchmark of deduplication correctness at scale, and one community comment flags automatic schema migration as undesirable in some workflows (though this is a configurable behavior, not a failure).
